project_info.theme: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra water and dust resistance poster
project_info.color_palette: White, graphite gray, white S Pen, black camera rings, transparent water droplets

main_subject.detail: Clean durability poster showing a close-up corner of the Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra covered with realistic water droplets beside a white S Pen, beneath a bold safety headline.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic macro product render, minimal durability campaign aesthetic

composition_elements.text: Safe from waterdrops and dust / Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra
items: Top Left: Large black headline 'Safe from waterdrops and dust'.
Top Right: Smaller subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra'.
Bottom Left: White S Pen entering diagonally from the lower-left corner.
Bottom Right: Dense multi-line legal and IP rating disclaimers in light gray.
Center/Background: Extreme close-up of the rear corner of a graphite Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra with two camera rings and many realistic water droplets across the surface.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean macro highlights on droplets, subtle matte-metal reflections, precise premium clarity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra water and dust resistance poster. Centerpiece is a macro close-up of the rear corner of a graphite Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra covered in realistic water droplets, paired with a white S Pen on a bright white background. Background is minimal and highly clinical. Surrounding elements: exact headline 'Safe from waterdrops and dust', subtitle 'Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra', and a long light-gray legal/IP disclaimer block at the bottom left. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, crisp droplet highlights and subtle matte-metal reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra rear-corner macro render with S Pen
assets.source: official Samsung render or original creative
assets.usage: Preserve camera-ring scale, edge cuts, S Pen angle, and surface finish.

assets.name: water droplet pattern

assets.name: durability headline and disclaimer block

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the exact macro crop and droplet pattern. Do not turn this into a lifestyle waterproof scene; it must remain a minimal close-up product proof visual.
